text: 辰谷刚换岗的联运协调员发言：北环货线陪同窗口建议二月每周增开一轮。银湾线也是我负责的。
P. Xu suggested weekly February coverage on the North Loop. The carrier has yet to agree.
北环例会提议另行议定。银湾、石岭两处的下一轮资料交换原则上定在三月，仅交换汇总指标。
The Freight Working Group confirmed a March exchange of aggregate metrics only, for Silver Bay and Shiling. The North Loop suggestion was not adopted in this meeting.
The former coordinator said the February service was a test suggestion, not a commitment. It related to North Loop only.
Correction to s4: March is the target month, with no exact date yet. The two routes and aggregate-only scope stand.
仅银湾仓的交接单提议下月试用。是否试用还得问港区，和资料交换不是一回事。
经协调组核对，同意对外说明银湾和石岭拟于三月交换汇总指标，具体日期待各方确认。
